## Checklist

- [ ] It's in its own folder: `addons/<YourAddonId>/` (letters, digits, `-` and `_`)
- [ ] `addon.json` has title, author, version, description and category
- [ ] Updating? I raised the `version` in `addon.json`
- [ ] I tried it in Elite Companion (copied the folder into the app's `Addons` folder) and it works
- [ ] It uses theme colours (`{StaticResource Hud}` etc.), not hard-coded ones, so it fits every theme
- [ ] If it goes online, `addon.json` lists the sites in `"web"` (only `edsm` and `spansh` are allowed)
- [ ] It's my own work, or I have permission to share it, and I'm happy for it to be shared under this repo's licence
- [ ] (Optional) a `preview.png` screenshot, about 600 × 340
